messages:
marcos (support): FYI incoming from tenant T-942: sporadic high latency + double billing on some requests, looks like some requests land in eu-west while tenant is pinned to us-west. Customer saw spikes during hedged requests. attaching snippet from their SDK logs.
marcos (support): logs: ```2026-03-15T14:01:02Z INFO hedged_request start region=us-west-2 req_id=rd-abc123
2026-03-15T14:01:02Z INFO hedged_request fallback region=eu-west-1 req_id=rd-abc123 latency=320ms
2026-03-15T14:01:02Z ERROR billing duplicate_charge tenant=T-942 req_id=rd-abc123 note=retry-executed```
maya_sre: ugh. sounds like the SDK sent parallel hedged requests to different endpoints and both succeeded. billing double-charge would fit if both responses were proxied to backend and created resources.
devon-eng: can you confirm SDK version and hedging config? hedging should only hit fallback when primary times out; if primary is slow but still succeeds, both could be processed.
marcos (support): customer says: sdk v1.4.2, default hedged=true, timeout=150ms, backoff random_jitter, prefer-region header set to us-west but not honored consistently.
lina-billing: if both requests create billable units, we need a mitigation ASAP. we can add detection and refund, but we need reproducible pattern to scope impacted tenants.
maya_sre: repro plan: 1) run client with hedged=true and low timeout in us-west route 2) run 1000 concurrent requests 3) observe route headers and request IDs across gateways. can someone run?
devon-eng: @marcos can you ask customer for raw request_id traces (rd-*) and the x-redwood-region header from responses? also need tenant API key and sample curl command + time window.
marcos (support): asked the customer for request ids and a pcap. they provided two request IDs that show same operation processed twice: rd-abc123 and rd-abc456. forwarded.
oncall-bot: incident created INC-2026-0325-17 assigned to eng-runtime priority=high
maya_sre: quick mitigation: set tenant-level config to disable hedging for T-942 and enable dedupe-by-id at the gateway. can support flip that change?
marcos (support): I can flip hedging off for the tenant right now, will do after quick heads-up to customer. want me to also block eu-west fallback route for them?
devon-eng: yes disable hedging + enforce prefer-region routing for that tenant until we root-cause. i also want kernel of logs from the gateway that show which backend accepted the request. ask infra to attach trace spans.
lina-billing: I'll draft temporary refund/credit policy for detected duplicates and tag invoices. need list of impacted request_ids (they sent two so far).
maya_sre: long-term: we should make hedged requests idempotent by default or ensure only one write op can commit (request dedupe token). filing an RFC after this triage.
marcos (support): customer confirmed hedging-off repro stops the double-charge. they're happy with temporary disable. opening an eng-runtime ticket to add dedupe and stricter prefer-region honoring. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
